content_fields.title: Validate and safely store uploaded files (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Validate the type, magic bytes and size of any binary content before storing it.
content_fields.finding: Remote image bytes are base64-encoded and stored with no content-type check, no magic-byte validation and no size limit.
content_fields.current_code:
def create_menu_item(
    db,
    menu_item: schemas.MenuItemCreate,
):
    menu_item_dict = menu_item.dict()
    image_url = menu_item_dict.pop("image_url", None)
    db_item = MenuItem(**menu_item_dict)

    if image_url:
        db_item.image_base64 = _image_url_to_base64(image_url)

    db.add(db_item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_item)

    return db_item
criteria: Content type is determined from the bytes, not from a client-supplied header or extension.
Only an explicit allow-list of formats is accepted.
A size ceiling is enforced before decoding.
Stored content is never served with a content type derived from user input.
